paragraphs.text: Mia and Sam go home with Dad. The rain is still heavy, so they cannot go to the park. The dog meets them. Mia hugs it.
Sam looks at the red collar. There is a blue star on it. ‘Look, Mia,’ he says. ‘I know this star.’ He comes back with an old photo. In the photo, a girl holds a brown and white dog.
‘That is Anna from school,’ Mia says. Anna is in their class, but she is not at school. Mia calls her friend Ben. ‘Do you have Anna’s number?’ she asks. Ben looks for his phone.
